workItems.title: Implement OTP bootstrap and recovery
workItems.summary: Replace password endpoints with non-enumerating server-verified email OTP and atomic just-in-time identity creation that grants only restricted assurance.
acceptanceCriteria: The browser cannot assert `pinVerified`.
OTP challenge verification is owned by the server.
One transaction consumes the challenge and creates a new user, personal account, and owner membership.
An existing email creates no identity rows.
Concurrent requests produce exactly one identity.
Responses are generic and do not permit enumeration.
OTP time-to-live is 10 minutes, maximum attempts are 5, resend delay is 60 seconds, and rate limits are configurable.
CSRF protection is enforced.
Successful OTP verification grants a restricted session only.
Remove password, sign-up, and reset handlers, schemas, OpenAPI operations, and `passport-local`.

Passkey persistence is mechanically adapted to the new schema so the API compiles, without granting anonymous registration or authentication authority; discoverable authentication semantics remain in AUTH-PWL-005.
scopeIn: apps/web/api/src/auth/** for email OTP, restricted sessions, password removal, removal of client-authoritative passkey flags, and the minimum mechanical passkey persistence adaptation required by the AUTH-PWL-003 schema
